name: Employee Break Room
description: A depressing room where hotel staff come to remember why they need this job. Uncomfortable chairs surround wobbly tables. A microwave that hasn't been cleaned since the hotel opened. A refrigerator labeled 'CLEAN OUT FRIDAYS' (it's never Friday). Motivational posters peel from walls: 'Hang in There!' shows a cat hanging from reality itself. A coffee maker produces liquid that's technically drinkable. Time cards punch themselves. The TV only gets one channel, and it's just management meetings.
